cells.gaps: No row gives the policy a period, a delivery plan, a mandated body or a budget line, and no report against its own targets has been found. The 2012 date is the publisher's, the page printing none, and adoption is read from publication and the minister's 2025 statement rather than from an adopting act. Nothing is dated inside the twelve months to the as-at.
cells.note: National ICT Policy 2012: adopted, its text public and no end year stated, so it is open and stops at stage 3. Stage 4 needs a period not ended, a delivery plan and results reported against the policy; only an unmeasured claim of implementation is held.
